primary_metric: RMSE of natural logarithmic SalePrice; lower is better
data_scope: Official 1460 labeled houses and 1459 unlabeled competition test rows. No external target data or downloaded prediction vectors.
validation: Shared seed42 shuffled 5-fold development split; all 1460 rows scored. Preprocessing fitted within training folds. Reused development folds and online feedback are explicitly adaptive.
initial_portfolio: Four noY TabPFN-v2 changes: fingerprint disabled, 90% context subsampling, domain features, up to 50 polynomial products. Exact specifications recorded before model execution by round6_tabpfn.py.

Four saved fixed blends audited: E08+15% classical, noY/domain 50/50, E08+20% BoxCox0.15, E08+20% nofingerprint. The last two rejected on development OOF; first two exported. This decision is already adaptive to saved prediction analysis.

One additional architecture: official TabICL v2 regressor, raw79 features, log target, eight estimators, seed42, fixed MPS full precision; possible fixed 80% E08/20% TabICL log blend. No weight search.
online_budget: At most 8 new submissions in this round; select candidates using local evidence, method diversity and available quota. Stop if no justified candidate remains.
publication_condition: Only claim Kaggle improvement after a completed authenticated submission strictly below 0.11064; associate score with the exact uploaded SHA256. If improved, publish new source, evidence and result through the verified SSH origin without force push.
prior_artifacts: Preserve the scored baseline and historical evidence. No correction of previous package implementation or hand-edited test-row predictions.
